symptom: an Accordion group with widgets in headerContent and content describes them all as the group's body; regenerating the page from the description stores the header widget in content (headerContent -> [txtHead], content -> [txtBody] became content -> [txtHead, txtBody]); and `headercontent { … }` inside a group fails check with MDL-WIDGET25 "not a widget in this project"
cause: extractObjectListItem appended every Widgets-typed sub-property of an item to one Children list; the widget-kind validator resolved no parent definition for a child of an object-list ITEM, so the item's own slot keyword fell through to the unknown-widget error even though the item builder's slot pass routes it
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_objectlist.go` (Slots, promoteBodySlot, objectListItemWidgetSlotKeys), `cmd_pages_describe_output.go`, `widget_engine.go` (bodyItemSlotKey shared with defaultItemSlotKey), `validate_widgets.go` / `validate_widget_kind.go` (parentItem, itemDeclaresSlot)
insight: Updating the existing page reported 'Unchanged page' and hid the loss — the round trip has to be run against a FRESH app, which is the regenerate-from-describe case the bug actually hurts. Map each widget to its slot by TypePointer -> PropertyKey in the JSON dump; the ndsl view does not show which slot a widget is in. The body rule (content, else first widget slot) now lives in one function both CREATE and DESCRIBE call. The fix needed both halves: an honest describe whose output check refuses is no better than a silent one
